title: feat(lint)!: refuse a lookupFilters { $record } path through or to a multi-valued field
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9HYSvbtx2THhVaC74JSSiEP)_

Fixes #34378

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — a `lookupFilters[].value` `{ $record }` path on a lookup, master_detail or user field whose first segment is a multi-valued field of the object owning that field (a plain path to it, or a hop through it), or whose leaf behind a single-valued hop is a multi-valued field, linted clean and published; it is now refused at error as `object-field-ref-unknown` by `os lint`, `os validate`, `os build` and the runtime publish door, and reported (never refused) on the package publish receipt's object probe.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #34201 — no doc or skill teaches `{ $record }` yet, so there is no teaching to correct here; the multi-valued clause rides the describes this change edits.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：查找字段 `lookupFilters` 里的 `{ $record: "路径" }`(读取正在编辑的记录)如果指向或穿过多值字段(`multiple: true` 的查找/选择/人员字段，或多选、复选框、标签字段),lint 现在直接报错并点名那个字段。
- 为什么改：`$record` 代表"一个值",只配 eq/ne/gt/lt/gte/lte 这类单值比较;多值字段是一个列表，之前 lint 照样放行，结果选择器要么悄悄丢掉这条过滤，要么拿列表去比单值，过滤看着对、实际不生效。
- 风险与回滚：只收紧同一条 lint 规则(`object-field-ref-unknown` 的 `$record` 成员);examples / 平台对象 / 插件 / skills / 文档样例实测 0 处写 `$record` 路径，无存量受影响。客户端半边(选择器丢弃该条并给开发提示)在 #34389,不在本 PR。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.ts`(`multiValuedSegment` 与 `$record` 槽位后的判读)、`packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts`(多值一组 8 条)、`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.lookup-filter-record-path-multi-valued-refused.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts`,预期 127 条全绿，其中多值一组 8 条。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `object-field-ref-unknown`, `lookupFilters[N].value.$record` member: a path that already resolves is judged for cardinality too (a new slot property `singleValued`, set only on that member). The predicate is spec's own `isMultiValueField` (`@objectstack/spec/data`), the one `FieldSchema` reads: an inherently multi type (`multiselect`, `checkboxes`, `tags`), or `multiple: true` on a multi-capable type. No second copy of the type list.
  - A multi-valued FIRST segment of the owning object is refused at the head, whether the path ends there (`tags`) or hops through it (`accounts.cb_market`): message `... names "tags", a multi-valued field ...` / `... goes through "accounts", a multi-valued field ...`.
  - Behind a single-valued hop, a multi-valued LEAF is refused at the leaf, naming the leaf's object (`account.markets` ends at `markets` on `crm_account`).
  - Judged only on a path the family's resolution did not already refuse (a misspelt leaf behind a multi hop is reported once, as the miss). A registry-injected column and a leaf on an object outside the stack stay unjudged, as today. A multi-valued head pointing outside the stack is still refused: the head is the owning object's own field.
  - Hint: `Point $record at a single-valued field ...`.
- `rule-explanations.ts`: the `$record` paragraph of `os explain object-field-ref-unknown` names the multi-valued refusal.
- `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`: the `LookupFilterRecordReferenceSchema` describe and the `lookupFilters[].value` describe each gain one clause: such a path has no single value, is not resolved, and lint refuses it. No client behaviour is claimed; the picker's handling is #34389 (named in the jsdoc only — the describes carry no tracker ids). The value describe keeps main's sentence on the server refusal of an unresolved `{ $record }`.
- ADR-0087 semantic entry `lookup-filter-record-path-multi-valued-refused` (template: `lookup-filter-record-path-unknown-refused`); the id does not collide on main at `0e2e4f56`.
- Regenerated `content/docs/references/data/field.mdx`.

### First-party exposure (measured at `7f731083`)

`git grep -lE` for a `$record:` key with a string value, outside `*.test.ts(x)` and `content/docs/references/**`: zero files in `examples/`, `packages/platform-objects`, `packages/plugins`, `packages/services`, `packages/qa`, `skills/`, `content/docs/` and `ui/examples`. Repo-wide the only hits are changesets, the spec/lint/core sources and semantic entries, and the ui picker reader. Positive control: the same expression counts 8 lines in `packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts`. Verdict: nothing first-party to judge; no shipped app's picker changes.

## Tests

`packages/lint/src/validate-object-field-refs.test.ts`, new block `a path through or to a multi-valued field` (8 cases); every refusal asserts `severity: 'error'`, `rule: OBJECT_FIELD_REF_UNKNOWN`, the path and the hint:

| case | verdict |
|:--|:--|
| plain path to `tags` | refused, `names "tags"` (full message pinned) |
| plain path to a `multiple: true` select | refused |
| hop through a `multiple: true` lookup `accounts.cb_market` | refused at the hop (full message pinned) |
| hop through a `multiple: true` user field | refused at the hop |
| hop through a multi lookup to an object outside the stack | refused at the head |
| multi-valued leaf `account.markets` behind a single hop | refused at the leaf, on `crm_account` (full message pinned) |
| misspelt leaf behind a multi hop | one finding, the miss |
| CONTROLS: plain single field, single lookup, single hop, `multiple: false` select, hop to an injected column | clean |

Forced edits to existing tests, named: the shared `quote` fixture's `crm_account` gains a `markets: multiselect` field (no existing case reads it), and the one-line-verdict fact list gains `a path through or to a multi-valued field`.

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; restored blob == HEAD)</summary>

Cardinality read disabled (`if (!hit && slot.singleValued) {` → guarded by an unset global marker): `Tests 6 failed | 121 passed (127)` — exactly the six refusal cases; the miss case and every control stayed green. Restored: blob `fd916767` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `./validate-object-field-refs.js` relatively (source, not `dist`), so no rebuild leg applies.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The resumed commits (`ff1bf727`, `5b520173`, `3781dec5`) came from a stopped thread with no report; every reading here was re-taken on this branch. Merging them onto main conflicted in the `lookupFilters[].value` describe with main's server-refusal sentence (#34330); both sentences are kept.
- The client still sends the list for a plain multi-valued path today; that half is #34389 (domain:ui). This PR touches no `ui/` file.

## Verification

Readings at head `7f731083` (merge of `origin/main` `e8cba8fe`; the incoming commits touch only `ui/`), after a full `pnpm build --concurrency=2` (119 tasks, VERDICT command-exit 0).

- `@objectstack/lint` `typecheck` exit 0; `test`: `Test Files 214 passed (214)`, `Tests 9091 passed (9091)`.
- `@objectstack/spec` `typecheck` exit 0; `vitest run src/data src/migrations`: `Test Files 178 passed (178)`, `Tests 6556 passed | 1 todo (6557)`.
- `@objectstack/cli` unit `test/explain-rule-id.test.ts` (iterates every `os explain` entry): `Tests 14 passed (14)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: `content/docs/references/**` stale until `gen:schema && gen:docs` regenerated `field.mdx` (committed); `check:test-typecheck` exit 0 when re-run with a 4 GB heap (the first run died in `tsc` without diagnostics, a heap reading, not a finding).
